source_scope: Reuse all32 H1an source banks and the same tie/cell streams; entirely new permutation corruption observations. No fresh-source generalization claim. Archived H1an collapse-filter results descriptive.
corruption_law: After fixing current mask, draw U~uniform[0,1) and uniform permutation pi of81 positions on every row. If U<9/160, observed board is clean[pi], otherwise clean. All queries and both repeated calibration labels share the board. No geometry or labels used to select permutation.
exact_laws: Uniform pi gives any fixed digit probability1/9 and every ordered pair of distinct source positions probability1/(81*80). Hence fixed-cell error(9/160)*(8/9)=1/20; each wrong digit1/160; true-peer equality(9/160)*(8/80)=9/1600. Repeated queried labels always agree. Position permutations conserve9 copies of each digit, so every25-cell subset passes balance filter.
acquisition: Unchanged H1an exposure mask learner and balance filter, same LR calibration and first-crossing rule. There is one new filtered acquisition per bank. Independent replay without filtering must match all masks/counts/exclusions/crossings because no row can be rejected; do not rerun duplicate acquisitions.
empirical_primary: At least16/32 banks lose at least one true edge under the permuted-board noise. Supports iff bank_count>=16, otherwise falsifies. Exact finite-bank target, no independent-edge confidence interval.
theorem_separation: Filter blindness, histogram conservation, fixed-cell error law and repeated-label agreement are mathematical predictions checked separately from empirical constraint damage. The H1ao clean-label retention theorem does not apply to accepted undetected corrupt labels.
independent_audits: Exact Fraction laws and all6480 ordered distinct source-position pairs,648 equal. Independent every-row uniform/permutation reconstruction and validity, all full source and corrupted digit histograms, observed-label multiplicities, Decimal80 calibration endpoint/predecessor and crossing thresholds, all masks/noise/LR/first-crossing states replayed without filter. No factorial enumeration claim.
budget: At most900 aggregate CPU seconds and180 wall seconds including preparation, all32 acquisitions, independent audits and summary; up to8 one-thread workers. Live owned-process CPU/wall counters enforce budgets. No GPU.
stopping_rule: Exactly32 source banks, all outcomes retained. No selection, follow-up source rows or solver work.
limitations: Specific board-shared position-permutation law, not arbitrary correlation.
Source banks reused from H1an; no fresh-source claim.
Scalar iid calibration is deliberately misspecified.
Global digit-balance prior does not establish cleanliness under this law.
No solver accuracy or invalid-certificate measurement. BP AdamW outside source-only scope; not run.
